heading: Beyond Engineering.
paragraphs: I'm an electronics engineer based in Cairo, focused on power electronics and analog PCB design: switch-mode supplies, isolated power, and Li-ion charging and protection.
My most complete project is the PSK Gate System, a race-timing gate for stadium tracks. I took it from schematic and layout through client validation and assembled 12 working units.
When a system misbehaves in the field, I look for the physical cause first. On the PSK Gate, sunrise interference on IR sensors was the cause, and a red-LED sensor removed it.
I check designs in LTspice and Simulink before committing to a board, then debug the result on the bench with an oscilloscope and multimeter.

I'm completing an M.Sc. in Mechatronics at Ain Shams University, researching analog front-end IC design for current and torque sensing. I'm looking for hardware design work in power electronics or analog PCB design, and I'm open to relocating.
